_comment: Ratchet ceilings for `jui conformance gate` (plan 06 §3), per render environment (plan 25 Phase 0).
missing_artifact: baseline entries whose fixture produced no screenshot this run — the way a fixture silently exits visual coverage.
no_baseline: screenshots that have no baseline hash (rendered but never compared).

Ceilings nest by environment key (baselines/<env>/): a visual count is a fact about one renderer, so its ceiling is too. An env with no entry gets ceiling 0 for everything — a fresh environment starts strict.
local: 0 across the board since the 2026-08-02 clean re-bake (baselines pruned to exactly the run's referenced screenshots; the old 12/6/4 were stale entries from accumulated artifacts directories).
ci: baselines are baked FROM a CI run's own artifacts, so the baseline set equals the rendered set by construction and both ceilings start at 0.

A count above its ceiling fails the gate. LOWERING a ceiling to match improved reality is routine and encouraged (the gate prints a notice when there is slack); RAISING one is a coverage regression and needs a justification comment here.

unreviewed: adjudication-ledger rows still carrying the 'unreviewed-initial-measurement' verdict — measured findings nobody has ruled on. Keyed by ledger filename and NOT nested by env: how many findings are unjudged is a fact about the repository, not about a renderer.

Armed 2026-08-07 (plan 51-H) after measuring what the existing ratchet actually caught. A finding with NO ledger row fails the gate (unrecorded), and a row the measurement no longer supports fails it (stale) — but `--update` folds a NEW finding in as a row whose reason is the unreviewed marker, and cross_effect.check() counts that row as ACCEPTED. That is the whole path by which plan 33's 'unreviewed 0' regrew to 126 rows after the fixture expansion: no bypass, just a device with no opinion about a row that records a finding and rules on nothing.

Ceilings are today's measured reality (cross_effect 41 after 51-H ruled on the six TextView/lineBreakMode rows; inert_audit 71 pending the 51-E2 lane), NOT a target. Committing them at reality is deliberate: gating an unconsumed queue makes red the normal color, which is the lane discipline. What this buys is monotonicity — the queue can no longer grow silently.
Every lane that burns rows down LOWERS its ledger's ceiling in the same commit as the ruling. 0 across the board is the finish line for the external audit's remaining condition.
